findings.finding: Client intentionally exposes only accountId/username/minecraftUUID and verified identity. roles/isAdmin/hash do not enter UI state. verified is not a casino-admin capability.

Endpoint returns signed-profile validity only. It creates no authenticated session, casino ownership grant, CSRF/write guard, or real-currency ledger. It must not authorize RTP changes merely because response is1.

checkUser validates HMAC only. Synthetic correctly signed timestamp1 and future timestamp are accepted. Future privileged session exchange must explicitly validate documented timestamp units, freshness and future skew before assigning capability.
SPW_APP_TOKEN is server-only. No platform financial or permission API is needed for the standalone localDEMO admin panel.

recommendation.currentDemo: Standalone ?demo-admin=1 may expose a clearly localDEMO control panel. Embedded miniapp remains failclosed because no server casino-admin capability exists.
recommendation.futureAuthorization: Server verifies signed identity/freshness, maps accountId through a configured casino-owner/admin allowlist, issues a short-lived authenticated session and a narrow math-profiles:write capability. Provider isAdmin/roles are not automatically casino ownership.
recommendation.writeBoundary: Validate capability on every mutation; same-origin/CSRF policy, revision compare-and-swap, append audit revision, global game preset allowlist, refuse while a round is computing and pin accepted-round profile beforeRNG. Client sends no per-user odds or past-loss inputs.
recommendation.leastPermissions: Use identity only to manage DEMO math settings; no wallet/cards/transfers/payment scopes or financial calls. Existing public SPW docs do not establish an OAuth-style fine-grained permission catalogue for this SDK; do not invent provider permission names.
recommendation.clientDTO: Expose only verified casino capability names/booleans and allowed preset IDs from server. Keep signed original claims and tokens server-side.
